title: BLOCK_RECORD writer identity slim projection
scope: Avoid deep-copying parser-only BLOCK_RECORD payloads into the short-lived DXF writer's source identity inventory.
Preserve all fields consumed by source block identity, layout-link, and extension-dictionary planning.

sourceChange.before: Initialize the writer inventory by copying every complete DRW_Block_Record from cData, including preview bitmap, DWG INSERT indexes, and table-entry auxiliary values; later clear xDictHandle for non-SORT owners.
sourceChange.after: Build writer inventory records field-by-field, copying only handle, name, layoutHandle, and xDictHandle, which are the fields read by dxfRW's source block identity planner and layout/extension link emitters. Preserve the existing non-SORT xDictHandle clearing and BLOCK-wrapper identity aliases.
sourceChange.effect: Retains the necessary writer metadata while avoiding deep copies of unused parser payloads and dynamic auxiliary fields. Public data classes and source dx_data remain unchanged.

focusedTests.coverageNote: Existing tests cover BLOCK_RECORD owner mapping, SORTENTSTABLE xDict ownership, layout and object graph writer/readback paths.

validation.diffCheck: passed for dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Closes one adapter-to-writer whole-record copy by projecting only proven writer-consumed fields. Compatibility and support gates remain unchanged.

testsRun: Strict adapter, fixture, and block-owner test target builds
Focused block-owner, SORTENTSTABLE, and DXF fixture CTests
method.limitations: No allocation instrumentation or peak-RSS measurement was run. The projection is justified by enumerating all m_sourceBlockRecords readers; it is not a general library memory bound.
